item.title: In-Browser Terrain Rendering with Godot and Terrain3D
item.description: For a while now I’ve been wanting to create a simple social networked game. Basically just a chat room where you can explore a 3D world, in browser. Recently, since I’ve been entering game jams for fun and learning the Godot Engine, I decided to actually work towards this dream. For a start, I grabbed this super helpful starter project to learn how the high level networking feature works in Godot.
